summary: Updated implementation plan adapting PurineSnap to a high-fidelity WeChat Mini Program (微信小程序) experience with a dual-mode interface: a realistic WeChat Mini Program client (standard capsule controls, bottom TabBar, photo analyzer, meal breakdown, biochemistry viewer) alongside a clean, full-featured Admin Management Console (简易管理后台) for data monitoring, food purine CMS, and AI/biochemical parameter settings.
